verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents programmatic machine creation through its REST API and CLI, with API keys for authentication, so an agent can provision GPU machines and configure type, template, region and start state. It can also run workloads via SSH, Deployments or Workflows. However, the evidence never shows programmatic monitoring or explicit deletion/teardown; auto-shutdown only stops a machine after inactivity. There is also no MCP server, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404. Missing for 10: documented API/CLI monitoring of machine state and metrics, explicit destroy/delete endpoint or command, MCP server, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration of a fully headless end-to-end lifecycle.
